units.source_text: 且说源氏公子回京，首先入宫参见父皇，将日来情状禀告。

en.t: After returning to the capital, Prince Genji first went to the palace to pay his respects to his imperial father and reported everything that had happened in recent days.

units.source_text: 皇上看见公子消瘦了许多，甚是担心，便探问老僧如何祈祷、治病，如何奏效等情况。

en.t: Seeing that the prince had grown much thinner, the Emperor was deeply worried and asked how the old monk had prayed, treated his illness, and how effective it had been.
The prince answered each question in careful detail.

units.source_text: 皇上说：“如此看来，此人可当阿阇梨了。

en.t: The Emperor said, "Judging from this, the man is worthy of becoming an acharya.

units.source_text: 他的修行功夫积得如此之深，而朝廷全未闻知。”

en.t: His religious practice has accumulated such depth, yet the court knew nothing of it at all."
He came to hold the old monk in very high regard.
At this time, the Minister of the Left entered the palace for an audience.

units.source_text: 他见了源氏公子，对他说道：“本来我也想到山中迎接，听说公子是微行的，恐有不便，因此未果。

en.t: When he saw Prince Genji, he said to him, "I had originally intended to go into the mountains to welcome you back, but when I heard that you had gone incognito, I feared it might be inconvenient and so did not do so.

units.source_text: 今后当静静地休息一两天。”

en.t: From now on, you should rest quietly for a day or two."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“现在我就送你回邸吧。”

en.t: Then he added, "I will escort you back to the residence now."

units.source_text: 源氏公子不想赴葵姬家，但情不可却，只得退朝前往。

en.t: Prince Genji did not want to go to Lady Aoi's house, but he could not refuse the obligation, so after leaving court he had no choice but to go.

units.source_text: 左大臣将自己的车子给源氏公子乘坐，自己坐在车后。

en.t: The Minister of the Left had Prince Genji ride in his own carriage, while he himself sat at the rear.

units.source_text: 源氏公子体察左大臣如此体贴入微的一片苦心，心中不胜抱歉。

en.t: Prince Genji understood the Minister of the Left's painstaking and thoughtful consideration, and felt deeply sorry in his heart.
